blocking_reasons.detail: No real, sealed Person B fold/split manifest exists on any branch. Every fold_manifest present in this repository is tests/fixtures/person_d/synthetic_b_fold_manifest.json, which is explicitly non-scientific test fixture data.

Person B's real capture-intake status for Person C's accepted trajectories is 'accepted_c_inputs_pending_person_a': the oracle-target math is content-complete on C's inputs alone, but the final target document cannot be sealed without Person A's real model_hash/preprocess_hash. No oracle_target_document exists on any branch outside synthetic fixtures.

what_is_ready_now: The exact scientific baseline input contract (schema_readiness gate) is implemented and tested: src/mineocclude/baselines/scientific_readiness.py.

The Registry v2-style owner-status/exact-artifact-authorization/manifest/verification-receipt schemas for D-owned baseline outputs are implemented and tested: src/mineocclude/baselines/registry_v2_artifacts.py.
Deterministic baseline prediction artifact IDs are implemented: build_baseline_prediction_artifact_id.

113 tests pass in tests/baselines, confirming the gate fails closed on every condition it must (UNASSIGNED_FOLD, missing sealed fold identity, missing oracle identity, scientific_use=forbidden, coverage mismatch, non-accepted candidate_scientific_use).
what_is_not_done: No scientific baseline prediction document has been generated or accepted.
docs/status/person_d_real_pilot_baseline_preview.json remains scientific_use=forbidden and must never be promoted to an accepted baseline; this job status record does not change that.

The three other Phase 4 SAVE deliverables (split_integrity.json, a metadata-leakage report, a written missingness_exclusion_report) remain unwritten to disk -- tracked separately, not part of this Step 4.1 handoff.
unblock_condition: This job becomes runnable the moment Person B publishes both a real, sealed fold manifest (validating against mineocclude.probes.splits.validate_fold_manifest) and a real oracle_target_document (validating against mineocclude.oracle.schema.validate_oracle_target_document with no fixture_metadata.scientific_use=forbidden marker). See runbook.md for the exact command and acceptance checks to run at that point.
next_check_action: git fetch origin role/person-b-methods and re-run scripts/prepare_step_4_1_registry_v2_handoff.py's underlying gate against B's real artifacts once they exist.
